contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary table lists a row 'Cocoa-containing fats (margarine etc.) | 0.34 | 13 | 4.20 | 5.8'; the primary Table 1 has 'Margarine' (0.02–2.5 µg/g, n 13, mean 0.34, intake 17.0 µg/day, F 4.8) with no cocoa reference. The cocoa attribution is unsupported and the intake/F values are wrong.

Stored summary lists several other Table 2 values that differ from the page image (e.g. peanuts 1.6-4.9 vs 1.6-3.9; almonds 1.0-1.5 vs 1.2-1.3; mushrooms/rye bread rows swapped) - not cocoa, noted for the shared-source owner.

Stored summary says the search was 'restricted to 1969-1982'; primary text says the search was established on 18 Feb 1982 and limited to years after 1969, supplemented with more recent literature and own investigations.
unresolved: Form of 'Cocoa' (powder vs beans) not stated; recorded as powder by inference only.
Analytical basis (as sold vs dry) not stated.
Sampling years of the underlying studies not stated in this review; would require refs 14, 27, 33.
Growing origins and purchase markets of the chocolate/cocoa samples not stated.
